title: juncus articulatus subsp. fontanesii
intro: Juncus articulatus subsp. fontanesii, commonly known as Fontanes' Rush or Rush, is a plant species within the Juncaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which can help in wound healing, reducing pain, and fighting off infections. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Juncus articulatus subsp. fontanesii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
